name: Furin Bell
description: A notification button drawn as a glass wind chime whose paper strip carries the unread count and which swings when something arrives.

props.name: count
props.description: Unread count, written on the paper strip. When it rises the bell is pushed and swings. Above 99 it reads 99+.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a short, quiet chime when the count rises, as the clapper first strikes the glass.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the button in pixels. The strip hangs below it by about the same again.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the bell is activated, for example to open a list.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. The unread count is added to it and announced when it changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the button and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the button. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.
